s1.text:
Round 4 — from your notes:
1. My day's sentence only counts what's on the plan: “A full afternoon. 9½ hours planned, 3½ free — most of it before 2.” No claims about things Navi didn't do.
2. Timeline · Calendar toggle on My day. Calendar opens on Week (Day too); Timeline stays the default.
3. Navi panel states: knows the page you're on, keeps draft and voice when closed, quiet badge, Focus holds non-urgent items.
4. Tucked away: ⌘K palette (small search icon in the sidebar) and “More details” on a task (hard deadline, estimate, repeat, reminder).
5. Sources board: every Navi sentence, the data it's built from, what happens when data is missing, and what Navi never says.

s2.text:
Your calls:
• Calendar opens on Week — or remember the last view?
• Search icon in the sidebar for ⌘K: keep, or keyboard only?
• Focus: only fixed events within 10 min and hard deadlines break through. Right line?
• Task reminders and “Not now” on suggestions each need a small new database field. OK to add (local first)?
• Approve round 4 → I start building the desktop shell.

s3.text:
Onboarding — as agreed:
• Invite-only. Google, or email with a 6-digit code; a password is the optional second way. No email links.
• Unfinished setup always lands here, from any page, and picks up at the same step on any device.
• Steps: Hello · The basics (name, timezone, wake-up, bedtime) · Talk it through (text or voice, live “What Navi's picked up”) · Review (nothing real until you turn it on) · Stay in touch (morning briefing at your wake-up time, evening 9 PM, quiet hours bedtime → wake-up) · Your first plan.
• “Do this later” on every step → Home shows “Finish setting up Navi” until done.

s4.text:
Mobile structure, as agreed:
• Three pages: Progress ← Navi chat → Plan. Swipe, or tap the labels at the top.
• Chat in the middle; a slim now/next line on top; Navi's first line comes from your data.
• ☰ opens your chats; your account sits bottom-left of that drawer (Settings, Memory, Notes, Activity).
• Plan opens on Day. Day · Week · List switch. Inbox is the pinned row at the top → sheet.
• The stone on Progress and Plan takes you to the chat with "About · this page".
• Focus and voice cover all pages. Voice can shrink to a talking bar while you keep working.

Try: Plan → Fit it in; Talk → shrink → swipe; type something → it lands in Inbox.

s5.text:
M1 Calmer — what changed:
• One box style, only for things you act on (proposals, approvals). Everything else is text; brightness does the hierarchy.
• Page names are quiet text; a small dot on Plan when something waits. New chat moved into the ☰ drawer.
• Chat: a fresh session opens on the greeting + at most one suggestion. Resuming keeps the conversation and scroll position.
• Plan: week strip behind the title; earlier items folded; actions show only on the next or selected block; “Still needs a time” ends the day.
• Progress: one sentence, one chart, one next step.
• Ask Navi: a quiet handle at the bottom of Plan/Progress opens a sheet that knows the context, grows into the full chat, and closes back.

Try in the prototype: Plan → tap the essay → Ask Navi → send → Move it → close.

s6.text:
M2 — what changed and why:
1. Type with real contrast: 34px titles, 26–30px two-tone Navi sentences, 17px chat text. Fewer sizes, more space.
2. Plan shows the day itself, to scale from now; free time is visible space. Views live behind the title (Friday ▾), Inbox behind one icon.
3. Progress is Navi reflecting: the week as stones filled by how much got done, one honest sentence, where time went, one question. Evening turns it into tonight's wrap-up.
4. Chat: plain large Navi text; “Done … Undo” inside the sentence; proposals preview the result with one button.
5. Fewer, stronger elements: one primary action per screen; a three-mark page indicator (the stone is Navi).
6. Ask Navi: a resting bar on Plan and Progress, a half sheet with context, grows into the full chat, closes back with Undo.
7. Voice and Focus unchanged; resuming keeps the conversation.

Try the prototype: Plan → tap the essay → tap the bar → send → Move it to Saturday → close.

s7.text:
M3 — refinements on M2:
• Chat: buttons name the action (“Add at 3:30 PM”, “Send Sam ‘1:00 PM?’”); receipts vs Navi’s words vs one decision card; urgent beats the greeting; “While you were away”.
• Plan: Day · Week · Tasks visible; one scale (48 px/h, 52 px minimum, long gaps folded); overlaps side by side + “Sort it out”; busy day with 3 approvals and 6 unscheduled.
• Progress: stones = kept ÷ planned-for-yourself (fixed things and moves with notice don’t count); tap a stone for evidence; reflections show sources + “Not quite”; Navi’s learned patterns need your OK; evening wrap-up is a conversation.
• Navigation: A sliding names (recommended), B marks that speak, C glass capsule. Switch with navStyle.
• Spec: stone states, gestures, motion, haptics, keyboard, safe areas, loading, offline, interruptions.

Try: Plan → Week/Tasks switch; Plan (busy) → Sort it out; Progress → tap Wednesday; Tonight → Wrap up today.

s8.text:
M4 — what changed:
• No fixed accent. The moment sets the palette: morning peach/rose, afternoon lime/aqua, evening gold/pink, night periwinkle. Green is just the afternoon.
• Focus sessions get a full scene coloured by the space (School dusk, Work still water, Health sunrise…).
• Five meaning colours never change: kept mint, slipping coral, steady lavender, needs-your-OK amber, new = the moment.
• Main buttons are gradients in the moment’s colours.
• New Opal-style flows: morning briefing story, focus session (setup → 3·2·1 → session → end early → done), weekly story, evening wrap-up.
• Progress reads like Opal’s home: stones, three numbers, coloured status words.

Try the prototype’s Tweaks: time = morning / evening / night.

s9.text:
M5 — Settings:
• Open it by tapping your name at the bottom of the chats drawer.
• Navi's colour: "The day" (default, M4 behaviour) or one of eight colours shared with the website. Live preview above the swatches.
• Your day, briefings and quiet hours, how much Navi does on its own, reminders and vibration on this phone, privacy, password, sign out.
• Every change saves at once; if a save fails it rolls back and says why.
• Swipe from the left edge to go back.
